description: List only actively saved places in this task to recover a forgotten P-ID or find earlier landmarks and search findings. Returns IDs and complete saved short notes in numeric P order, total and next_offset; follow next_offset for more. Automatic unannotated observation sites are excluded. After choosing an ID, use inspect_place in a later turn for historical photos and details. Notes retain model interpretations and uncertainty; this is task-local historical memory, not a new observation. Reads the latest saved state without images or movement.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into saved places; start at 0 and use returned next_offset to continue.

limit.description: Maximum number of saved entries to return (1 to 20).
